company_overview: Postman provides an API platform that lets users design, test, manage, and distribute APIs throughout the development lifecycle. It combines collaboration tools, governance, and AI‑assisted features for enterprise‑scale API work.
target_audience: Engineers and developers who build, test, and manage APIs and services, especially in enterprise environments

company_overview: Supabase provides a fully managed Postgres‑based development platform that bundles a database, authentication, auto‑generated APIs, realtime sync, storage, edge functions, and vector search. It enables teams to build, scale, and secure applications without managing infrastructure.
target_audience: Developers and product teams building web, mobile, or AI applications who need a complete Postgres backend with auth, APIs, storage, and serverless functions.

company_overview: Vapi provides an open voice‑agent platform that lets enterprises build, test, deploy and continuously improve AI‑powered voice agents. The service handles infrastructure, telephony, monitoring and compliance so customers can launch voice AI quickly at scale.
target_audience: Enterprises and developers building voice AI agents for use cases such as customer support, lead qualification, and appointment scheduling.
